name: oasis-nicaragua-root
description: Orquestador central para el backend y frontend de Oasis Nicaragua

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix Backend" "npm run dev --prefix Frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: npx concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix Backend" "npm run start --prefix Frontend"
